title: Training Meals
overview: Ryoga challenges Ranma, but Ranma's battles with Cologne have made him far stronger. When Cologne appears before the vengeful Ryoga, what is her motive?

title: The Breaking Point
overview: Akane tags along for Ranma's training, while Ryoga works to master the deadly "The Breaking Point." How will their clash unfold when Akane gets involved?

title: Happosai Days Are Here Again
overview: The Tendo family hits the beach. As Happosai runs wild, Ranma tries to set him up with Cologne — but it seems they share a past tied to an heirloom.

title: The Way of Tea
overview: A man on a wild horse grabs Ranma. The culprit: Sentaro, heir of the Daimonji School of Martial Arts Tea Ceremony. A fierce succession battle begins!
